title: Enhancing HER performance via nitrogen defects: a comparative DFT study of Fe and Ru single-atom catalysts on graphene
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,7682-7692
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA09113B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Hongyu Yang, Xin Xia, Shijie An, Moujie Huang, Hao Ma, Feng Ye, Chuang Peng, Chao Xu
In this work we systematically explored the stability of N to 4N defect substitution in graphene and highlighted the effect of nitrogen coordination environments on the HER activity of Ru and Fe SACs supported on N-doped substrate.
